All areas served

Your building project, in the Pays de Gex.

Based in Gex, Création & Rénovation Gessienne works across the Pays de Gex on masonry, plastering, partitions and tiling. Whether you want to rearrange a room, repair a wall or replace a finish, the project starts with your home and how you use it.

Describe my project in this area

Start with the existing space.

The condition of walls and floors, changes in level, openings and routes between rooms help define the work to consider. Before choosing a solution, explain what you want to keep and what needs to change. Approximate dimensions and wider views help prepare the first conversation; they do not replace an assessment of the surfaces.

Plan the work around everyday life.

If you will remain in the property during the work, explain which rooms need to stay accessible. Protection, delivery routes for materials and available working space are all part of the preparation. Where partitions and tiling are combined, the order of work also helps anticipate junctions and finishing details.

Based in Gex, focused on your address.

From Gex to Ferney-Voltaire, Prévessin-Moëns or Saint-Genis-Pouilly, the town alone does not describe a building project. Include the address, floor level where relevant, parking and delivery conditions. For a project in Ornex or Divonne-les-Bains, as elsewhere in the area, the scope and working arrangements are discussed before proceeding.

Trades that work together.

Explore the services to identify the work on your walls, layout and finishes.

Before you begin.

Do you work only in Gex?

The company is based in Gex and also works across the Pays de Gex. Tell us the town and type of work so we can discuss the arrangements for your address.

Can I include several types of work in one enquiry?

Yes. Describe the rooms involved and distinguish the masonry, partitioning, plastering and tiling work. We can then examine how they relate to each other and define the scope.
